key.name: hide-system-cursor
key.description: Attempt to hide the real OS pointer so only the custom cursor overlay is visible. Support for this can vary by GNOME/Mutter version, so it's kept as an opt-in toggle rather than always on.

key.name: cursor-scale
key.description: Size of the custom cursor overlay, as a percentage of its default size. Scaling happens around the cursor's hotspot, so click accuracy is unaffected by size.
